purpose: Copy-only 222-connection mixed digital and low-level analog geometry stress benchmark; every electrical, timing, audio and ESD acceptance remains blocked

unverified: All per-group missing_electrical_checks recorded in scope_review
Analog noise, bias/reference values, feedback stability, loading and temperature drift

scope.description: 147 exact RF-board nets / 222 native remaining connections: 148 connections in reviewed digital/control/bus groups and 74 connections in coherent low-level analog audio paths. Full native 80 x 150 mm board and original copper/obstacles retained. This complements UI252 for a 474-connection stress workload across two independent boards; no claim of one 474-connection board.

selection: Only full selected connectivity, independent native DRC/parity, unchanged rules and preservation, and added copper inside ROI qualify geometrically; compare time/vias/length on the Pareto frontier. No electrical acceptance.

scope_review.basis: Read-only KiCad native connectivity with every selected pad resolved through H2 controlled-symbol pin maps and endpoint/instance ledgers. Explicit digital/analog group review; routing class and GENERAL_CONTROL fallback never establish electrical acceptance.
